Method of Attack: Information exposure vulnerability in improperly configured Pega Infinity customer management system instances
Exploitation via misconfigured Pega Chat Access Group portal instance allowing attackers to run queries, retrieve database tables, OAuth access tokens, and perform administrative actions
Broken access control leading to data exfiltration and account takeovers
Impacted Systems: Backend web panel of Pega Chat Access Group portal instance
Attack Vector: Accessing misconfigured Pega Chat Access Group portal backend web panel via URL arguments
